dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「にっいさ〜ん。起きてくださ〜い」
dialogues.en: "Nii~san. Wake up."
dialogues.text: "Nii~san. Wake up."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「朝だよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Time to wake up."
dialogues.text: "Time to wake up."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……駄目、か。まぁ、無理に誘ったのは私だ
　からね」
dialogues.en: "......It's not working. Well, it's my fault."
dialogues.text: "......It's not working. Well, it's my fault."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「本当に仕方ない……書置きしとこ」
dialogues.en: "It's too bad...... I must say."
dialogues.text: "It's too bad...... I must say."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「えー、先に行きます。無理して来なくても大
　丈夫だからね……追伸。冷蔵庫に私の作った
　朝ご飯があるので残さず――」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I'm going without you. You don't have to come if you
can't make it. ......P.S. I made breakfast for you, it's in
the fridge----"
dialogues.text:
"Well, I'm going without you. You don't have to come if you
can't make it. ......P.S. I made breakfast for you, it's in
the fridge----"

dialogues.jp:
マットに沈められたボクサーのように、渾身の
力で腕を支えに起き上がる。
dialogues.en:
I got up, leaning on my arm with all the power I had, like a
boxer who was knocked down on a mat.
dialogues.text:
I got up, leaning on my arm with all the power I had, like a
boxer who was knocked down on a mat.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、起きた」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you're awake."
dialogues.text: "Oh, you're awake."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「く……起きるわな、そりゃ」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... Yes, of course."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... Yes, of course."

dialogues.jp:
のろのろ、と上半身を起こし、頭をかきながら
寝ぼけまなこを巡らす。
dialogues.en: I got up slowly, scratching my hair and looking around.
dialogues.text: I got up slowly, scratching my hair and looking around.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「おはよう兄さん♪　外、だんだんと暖かくなっ
　てきてるよ」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, niisan. It's getting warm outside."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, niisan. It's getting warm outside."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「春になると、もっと起きれなくなる気がする
　ぞ俺は……」
dialogues.en: "I think it'll be harder to wake up in spring."
dialogues.text: "I think it'll be harder to wake up in spring."

dialogues.jp:
確かに窓の外は、暖かそうな日の光に満ち溢れ
ている。
dialogues.en: The outside is filled with nice warm sunshine.
dialogues.text: The outside is filled with nice warm sunshine.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「冬にも寒くて布団から起きられないって言っ
　てたじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"You said you can't wake up in winter because you can't get
out of bed."
dialogues.text:
"You said you can't wake up in winter because you can't get
out of bed."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あれは強制、こっちは自らの信念だ」
dialogues.en: "That was mandatory and this is based on my will."
dialogues.text: "That was mandatory and this is based on my will."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「信念で寝坊してどうするのよ……ともかく、
　早く制服に着替えて」
dialogues.en:
"Don't sleep in willingly...... Anyway, you need to change
into your school uniform now."
dialogues.text:
"Don't sleep in willingly...... Anyway, you need to change
into your school uniform now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「え、あれ、なんだ？　どっか行く約束してたっ
　け」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What? Am I supposed to go somewhere?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What? Am I supposed to go somewhere?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうよ……デ・エ・ト♪」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... We have a date."
dialogues.text: "Yes...... We have a date."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see."

dialogues.jp:
背伸びをしてまぶたをこすり、音夢が差し出し
てきた制服を受け取る。
dialogues.en:
I stretched and rubbed my eyes. Nemu handed me my school
uniform.
dialogues.text:
I stretched and rubbed my eyes. Nemu handed me my school
uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「……風紀委員の手伝いだっけ？」
dialogues.en: "......So, I'm helping the school committee work?"
dialogues.text: "......So, I'm helping the school committee work?"

dialogues.jp:
せっかくの春休みだと言うのに、目覚まし時計
の時刻はいつもとなんら変わりがない。
dialogues.en: It's spring break, but my clock says the same time as usual.
dialogues.text: It's spring break, but my clock says the same time as usual.

dialogues.jp:
だが、まぁ、勉強するために学園に行くわけで
はないので抵抗は思ったより少ない。
dialogues.en:
But it doesn't feel as bad as I thought since I'm not going
to school to study.
dialogues.text:
But it doesn't feel as bad as I thought since I'm not going
to school to study.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「違うわよ。お仕事じゃありません」
dialogues.en: "No, it's not work."
dialogues.text: "No, it's not work."

dialogues.jp:
廊下に出ようとしていた音夢が、楽しそうに振
り返る。
dialogues.en:
Nemu turns around happily as she was going out in to the
hallway.
dialogues.text:
Nemu turns around happily as she was going out in to the
hallway.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「デート♪」
dialogues.en: "It's a date."
dialogues.text: "It's a date."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「分かったよ」
dialogues.en: "Fine."
dialogues.text: "Fine."

dialogues.jp:
苦笑いを浮かべつつの答えに、音夢も小さく微
笑んで部屋から消えた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu smiled and disappeared as I answered with a wry smile
on my face.
dialogues.text:
Nemu smiled and disappeared as I answered with a wry smile
on my face.

dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ……なんだこれ？」
dialogues.en: "Phew...... What's this?"
dialogues.text: "Phew...... What's this?"

dialogues.jp: 頬をこする。
dialogues.en: I rubbed my cheeks.
dialogues.text: I rubbed my cheeks.

dialogues.jp:
なぜだか熱でもあるかのように、頬が赤くなっ
ているのが分かった。
dialogues.en: I knew my cheeks were red as if I had a fever.
dialogues.text: I knew my cheeks were red as if I had a fever.

dialogues.jp: 心臓が激しく脈打つのが分かった……。
dialogues.en: And I felt my heart pounding fast......
dialogues.text: And I felt my heart pounding fast......

dialogues.jp: ◆信念で寝坊◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sleeping in as my philosophy◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sleeping in as my philosophy◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢に起こされ制服を渡される。そう言えば、
風紀委員の仕事を手伝うことにしたんだっけ。
dialogues.en:
Nemu woke me up and handed me the school uniform. I remember
I had to help Nemu with the school committee work.
dialogues.text:
Nemu woke me up and handed me the school uniform. I remember
I had to help Nemu with the school committee work.

dialogues.jp:
制服に着替え、音夢のいう“デ・エ・ト”の準
備をする。
dialogues.en:
I changed into school uniform and got ready for the "date"
as she put it.
dialogues.text:
I changed into school uniform and got ready for the "date"
as she put it.
